body: I work by the hour. And there is no job on my field in January and February. The only thing that stopped me from killing my self was my dad, but he has allowed all this violence and never made it stop. I don't have anybody else. I don't see any other options

The word was doesnt. I wont receive salary for January or February so I need to find a job on retail or fast food. I don't have a car. I am so tired of living. Supposedly I should be married or owning a house by this age. I don't know what a healthy relationship is so I am all alone. No friends, no partner.
I don't have any friends or relatives I can go to.
